figures.finding: China's Copyright Law gives the copyright in a film or television drama to its producer; the screenwriter keeps the right to be credited and the right to be paid under the contract signed with the producer, and may use the script on its own.
figures.applies: Films and television dramas made in China; Copyright Law art. 17, in force from 1 June 2021.

sources.said: 第十七条 视听作品中的电影作品、电视剧作品的著作权由制作者享有，但编剧、导演、摄影、作词、作曲等作者享有署名权，并有权按照与制作者签订的合同获得报酬。 … 视听作品中的剧本、音乐等可以单独使用的作品的作者有权单独行使其著作权。
